key_insight: Diamond color defects represent a promising technology for the development of large-scale quantum networks due to their advantageous optical and spin properties.
engineering_relevance: The integration of diamond nanophotonic structures with photonic circuits enhances the efficiency and scalability of quantum processor architectures.
method: Review of optical and spin properties of diamond color defects.
Discussion on recent advancements in quantum network building blocks.
Evaluation of challenges faced in practical implementations.
evidence_signal: The paper discusses recent demonstrations of metropolitan-scale quantum networks using diamond color defects.
watch_item: Challenges remain in the experimental realization and scalability of these quantum networks.
paper_title: Quantum Networks Using Color Defects in Diamond: Principles, Progress, and Perspectives
